title: The Chick and the Shell
summary: A chick breaks out of its shell with determination while other animals help.

pages.text: A chick sat in a shell.
pages.scene: A white egg with a small chick inside, waiting
The egg beginning to crack with tiny lines
The chick pecking at the shell from inside

pages.text: A fish will check on it.
pages.scene: A colorful fish swimming nearby, watching the egg

pages.text: The shell will crack and split.
pages.scene: Large cracks appearing across the egg shell
Pieces of shell breaking away, chick pushing hard
A wet, fluffy chick emerging triumphantly

pages.text: The chick can sing and hop.
pages.scene: Baby chick chirping with wings spread wide

pages.text: We will help the chick thrive.

pages.scene: Happy chick with friends, joyful atmosphere
The young chick standing proudly with friends
All animals together in a sunny barn setting
